text: You put on a pair of socks and a pair of shoes. How many items is that on your feet?
Fill the gap in the five times table: 5, 10, 15, ?, 25.
In a February that isn't a leap year, what's the most Fridays it can have?
why: 28 days is exactly four weeks, so every weekday appears four times.

text: Which weighs more: a kilogram of feathers or 900 grams of bricks?
why: 1,000 grams beats 900 grams, whatever it's made of.

text: Use the digits 1, 2, 3 and 4 once each to make two two-digit numbers with the biggest possible product. What is that product?
Gran is older than Aunt Jo, and Aunt Jo is older than Uncle Pete. Who's the youngest of the three?
why: Gran > Jo > Pete, so Pete is youngest.

text: Mum is 34 and her son is 8. How old will Mum be when her son turns 20?
A pack of six bread rolls costs £1.50. What's the price of one roll?
Grandad's Whitby train departs at 10:50 and the trip lasts 25 minutes. When does he get there?
why: 10 minutes takes it to 11:00, then 15 more.

text: At the chippy, a fish and a portion of chips come to £4 in total. The fish is £3 dearer than the chips. How much are the chips?
Your phone battery is at 40% and drops 5% every hour. How many hours until it's dead?
